# linux_command (Data Source)

Runs a shell script with `/bin/sh` and exposes its output. The script runs on every plan: it should not change anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_command" "kernel" {
  command = "uname -r"
}

output "kernel" {
  value = trimspace(data.linux_command.kernel.stdout)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Script to run.

### Optional

- `allow_failure` (Boolean) Report a non-zero exit status in `exit_code` instead of failing. Defaults to `false`.
- `environment` (Map of String) Environment variables exported to the script.
- `working_directory` (String) Directory the script runs in.

### Read-Only

- `exit_code` (Number) Exit status.
- `id` (String) Digest of the command.
- `stderr` (String) Standard error.
- `stdout` (String) Standard output.
